conditions: The ON statement supplies an ON-unit and the specified condition is enabled when raised.
limitations: REVERT, another ON statement or termination of the establishing block can end or override the association. Implicit SYSTEM actions, diagnostics, and the point of return from an ON-unit have separate rules.

triggers: Publisher correction, exact source byte drift, or contrary release or language-boundary evidence.

statement: In the IBM 6.1 reference, executing an ON statement with an ON-unit establishes the action for a subsequent raising of the specified enabled condition. The action can apply in dynamically descended blocks while it remains established.
